title: Choose Perry's look
question: The roll assigned the Saturday-morning title card. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Saturday-Morning Title Card
options.lineage: cartoon episode title cards and their iris-wipe transitions
options.thesis: Every step of the demo opens like a new episode: one bold title card, then the evidence.
options.viewport: A teal title band names the mission and its one-line objective; below it, four step tiles with fixed state marks and the headline verified result in display-size numbers.
options.risk: Tips into kids' TV if the type and color get cute instead of confident.

raised.raise: Numbers carry hierarchy by scale alone: results at display size against small labels.
Every state is one mark in a fixed spot: filled done, hollow not yet, green verified, red turned away.
The three ways in are always drawn at the same scale on one baseline, so the comparison is honest at a glance.
Nothing is labeled twice: each fact appears once, where it's used.

options.label: The Mission Dossier
options.lineage: secret-agent case files and briefing folders
options.thesis: Each step is a briefing in the agent's case file; every verified result gets stamped.
options.viewport: A navy folder with tabbed steps; the open briefing shows the objective, evidence and a stamped VERIFIED result.
options.risk: The most familiar reading of 'agent': it's where most runs on this brief would land.

options.label: Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: The demo is a ticket book: each step is a coupon that gets validated, used or voided.
options.viewport: Four coupons in sequence across the top; the open coupon shows the step's work, its fare box holding the cost per purchase.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: steps map to coupons and verified maps to validated; loses narrowly on audience identification.
options.risk: Reads as travel, not shopping, if the coupons dominate.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: A sticky yellow sign band always shows the next step and how far along you are.
options.viewport: A yellow band across the top names the next step with a monumental number; the page below holds only that step's work.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity: a demo is a chain of decision points; loses on the Perry identity.
options.risk: Strong yellow can crowd out the data if it's used for anything but wayfinding.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Hierarchy carried by scale contrast alone.
options.viewport: One giant figure with tiny labels.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither judges nor store teams identify with type design.
options.risk: Becomes a type demo, not a product.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast: results at display size against small labels.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and reversal.
options.viewport: Raked slides along a lit bed.
options.case: Fuses poorly: raked containers fight a working screen's clarity.
options.kept: State as a mark in a fixed cell: filled done, hollow not yet, green verified, red turned away.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One subject at the same scale through every stage.
options.viewport: Five fixed-scale plates on one baseline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no one identifies Perry with botany.
options.kept: The three ways in are always drawn at the same scale on one baseline.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Everything gets a catalog number; nothing is labeled twice.
options.viewport: A black field with one plot and a number.
options.case: Fuses poorly: coded labels work against first-time judges.
options.kept: Nothing is labeled twice: each fact appears once, where it's used.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS dashboard: side navigation, cards and charts, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Side rail with the four steps; an overview with stat cards and the result chart.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dashboard by design.
